reasons: Detection is accurate: § 12.4 is a one-way covenant on Customer that is a no-hire ('solicit, hire, or employ'), covers all Vendor employees, runs 24 months post-term, and expressly negates any unsolicited-approach/general-advertising carve-out ('regardless of how the employee applies') — squarely within the walk-away triggers.

The redline (deletion of p0045) matches the preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer') and the redline guidance to 'delete any no-hire'; since the entire paragraph is a no-hire with no salvageable non-solicit language, wholesale deletion is the minimal effective edit rather than an overreach.

Deletion also resolves an internal contradiction with § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment — a strong, citable negotiation basis included in the comment.

Comment is concise, first-person plural, playbook-prefixed, states what changed and why, and offers the exact fallback (mutual, personnel directly involved, 12 months from end of involvement, general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire).
The failing deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months 'number not found'; no carve-out present) are consistent with the clause having been removed and do not indicate a defective edit.
